verdict.rationale: Requesty's own docs say it makes every supported model output structured JSON. This covers both json_object mode and strict, schema-enforced json_schema mode, with consistent behavior regardless of the underlying provider, which matches the cross-provider schema story directly. The prompt library can also store structured output formats. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that schema enforcement works across providers, and documented per-provider limitations.

support.subject: As a developer, I can request structured JSON-schema outputs across providers

citations.quote: Requesty makes every supported model speak structured JSON — from simple json_object mode to strict, schema-enforced json_schema mode. One API, consistent behavior, regardless of the underlying provider.
